lessons.title: Family and friends
lessons.summary: Words for the people around you.

words.definition: a female parent
words.example: My mother cooks dinner every evening.

words.definition: a male parent
words.example: My father drives to work.

words.definition: a girl or woman with the same parents as you
words.example: My sister is two years older than me.

words.definition: a boy or man with the same parents as you
words.example: My brother plays football.

words.definition: the child of your aunt or uncle
words.example: My cousin lives in another town.

words.definition: a person who lives near you
words.example: Our neighbour says hello every morning.

questions.prompt: A person who lives near you is your ___.
questions.why: A neighbour is a person who lives near you.

questions.prompt: Your mother's sister's daughter is your ___.
questions.why: A cousin is the child of your aunt or uncle.

questions.prompt: Which word means "a male parent"?
questions.why: A father is a male parent.

questions.prompt: My ___ and I have the same parents. She is two years older than me.
questions.why: A sister has the same parents as you.

questions.prompt: Which word means "a female parent"?
questions.why: A mother is a female parent.

words.definition: the first meal of the day
words.example: I eat breakfast at seven.

words.definition: the meal in the middle of the day
words.example: We have lunch at school.

words.definition: the main meal in the evening
words.example: Dinner is ready at eight.

words.definition: wanting to eat
words.example: I am hungry after the long walk.

words.definition: wanting to drink
words.example: The children are thirsty on a hot day.

words.definition: instructions for cooking a dish
words.example: She follows a recipe to bake a cake.

questions.prompt: Which word means "the first meal of the day"?
questions.why: Breakfast is the first meal of the day.

questions.prompt: I am ___. I want a glass of water.
questions.why: Thirsty means wanting to drink.

questions.prompt: She follows a ___ to bake a cake.
questions.why: A recipe is a set of instructions for cooking a dish.

questions.prompt: We eat ___ in the evening.
questions.why: Dinner is the main meal in the evening.

questions.prompt: I have not eaten all day. I am very ___.
questions.why: Hungry means wanting to eat.

words.definition: a place where people buy and sell things
words.example: We buy vegetables at the market.

words.definition: a place where doctors treat sick people
words.example: The hospital is near the bus station.

words.definition: a place where people keep money
words.example: He goes to the bank on Friday.

words.definition: a place where buses or trains stop
words.example: I wait at the station for the train.

words.definition: a road in a town with buildings on it
words.example: Our school is on this street.

words.definition: a place where you can borrow books
words.example: She reads at the library after class.

questions.prompt: You can borrow books at a ___.
questions.why: A library is a place where you can borrow books.

questions.prompt: Doctors treat sick people in a ___.
questions.why: A hospital is a place where doctors treat sick people.

questions.prompt: He keeps his money in a ___.
questions.why: A bank is a place where people keep money.

questions.prompt: We wait at the ___ for the train.
questions.why: A station is a place where buses or trains stop.

questions.prompt: Which word means "a place where people buy and sell things"?
questions.why: A market is a place where people buy and sell things.

lessons.title: Time and routine
lessons.summary: Parts of the day and how often things happen.

words.definition: the first part of the day
words.example: I study in the morning.

words.definition: the part of the day after noon and before evening
words.example: We play football in the afternoon.

words.definition: the part of the day before night
words.example: We watch the news in the evening.

words.definition: before the usual or expected time
words.example: I wake up early on school days.

words.definition: after the usual or expected time
words.example: He was late for the lesson.

words.definition: every time
words.example: She always says thank you.

questions.prompt: The first part of the day is the ___.
questions.why: The morning is the first part of the day.

questions.prompt: The bus comes at six. I wake up at five, so I am ___.
questions.why: Early means before the usual or expected time.

questions.prompt: He arrived after the lesson started, so he was ___.
questions.why: Late means after the usual or expected time.

questions.prompt: I ___ brush my teeth before bed. I never forget.
questions.why: Always means every time.

questions.prompt: The part of the day after noon and before evening is the ___.
questions.why: The afternoon is the part of the day after noon and before evening.
